dataset_title: DNA-based sensors for nucleic acid detection dataset

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one quantitative measurement record

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Identifier linking the record to an entry in specs/source_map.json

fields.name: sensor_architecture
fields.description: Architecture of the DNA-based sensor

fields.name: dnazyme_name
fields.description: DNAzyme name as reported in the source or database

fields.name: full_sensor_sequence
fields.description: Complete DNAzyme sensor sequence or construct sequence if reported

fields.name: target_name
fields.description: Name or label of the nucleic-acid target

fields.name: target_sequence
fields.description: Sequence of the matched target analyte. If the source reports RNA, store U instead of T

fields.name: reaction_type
fields.description: DNAzyme reaction

fields.name: detection_method
fields.description: Detection method

fields.name: measurement_type
fields.description: Type of experimentally reported quantitative performance measurement

fields.name: measurement_value
fields.description: Numerical value of the reported measurement. For ranges, store the main value if reported and describe the range in notes

fields.name: measurement_unit
fields.description: Original unit of the reported measurement

fields.name: lod_nM
fields.description: LOD converted to nM when measurement_type is LOD

fields.name: signal_to_background_ratio
fields.description: Signal-to-background ratio reported for the sensor response

fields.name: temperature_c
fields.description: Assay temperature in degrees Celsius when a single temperature is reported

fields.name: gibbs_energy
fields.description: Predicted or reported Gibbs free energy for relevant probe-target hybridization, in kcal/mol. This is optional because many experimental papers report sensor performance without ΔG

fields.name: gibbs_energy_source
fields.description: Whether Gibbs energy was extracted from the source or calculated during curation

fields.name: buffer
fields.description: Buffer or assay medium composition

fields.name: pH
fields.description: Assay pH

fields.name: Mg_mM
fields.description: Mg2+ concentration in millimolar

fields.name: Na_mM
fields.description: Na+ concentration in millimolar

fields.name: fluorophore
fields.description: Fluorophore label used in the reporter probe

fields.name: quencher
fields.description: Quencher label used in the reporter probe

fields.name: method
fields.description: Experimental readout or measurement method

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: URL or landing page for the source

fields.name: source_location
fields.description: Exact location of the value in the source

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-text notes about extraction, ambiguity, assumptions, unit conversion, or special assay conditions.
fields.example: LOD measured in the presence of 500 nM mismatched rs87C analyte.
